correctness.rationale: For a colored vertex of color c in a row, local majority reduces exactly to 2(a_{r,c}+eta)>=s_r+epsilon. Summation forces any row with three distinct colors to have precisely three singleton colors and partner vertices in the other row with the same colors, precluding a fourth global color. Four global colors therefore require two disjoint color palettes across the rows, equal multiplicities within each row, even nonzero row supports and no overlapping selected columns; conversely these conditions give equality in every local inequality. Separate n=2 and n=3 constructions/obstructions give psi_sq(R_n)=min(n,4). Choosing disjoint 2a and 2b column sets and splitting each into two unlabeled equal classes gives Q_n=n!/4 sum 1/(a!^2 b!^2 (n-2a-2b)!) and EGF e^t/4(sum_{a>=1}t^{2a}/(a!)^2)^2. Independent exhaustive restricted-growth support/partition enumeration for n=2..5 inspected respectively 52, 877, 21,147, and 678,570 assignments, confirming maxima 2,3,4,4 and Q4=6,Q5=30. The general formula follows from the structural argument rather than extrapolation.
